Configuration for pre-commit hooks to check file formats, run linters, and execute tests.

# Purpose
The `.pre-commit-config.yaml` file configures pre-commit hooks for a codebase. It specifies repositories and hooks to run before committing code changes. The configuration includes hooks from the `pre-commit-hooks` repository, such as `check-added-large-files`, `check-toml`, `check-yaml`, `end-of-file-fixer`, and `trailing-whitespace`, which help maintain code quality by checking for large files, validating file formats, and fixing common issues. The file also includes hooks from the `ruff-pre-commit` repository for linting and formatting using `ruff`. Additionally, local hooks are defined to propagate dependency updates and run unit tests with `pytest`. The `exclude` directive prevents the hooks from running on files in the specified directory.
